description: Get a temporary, downloadable URL for a document by its file name (optionally converting XML/CDA to html or pdf). Medical API: GET /medical/v1/document/download-url.

conversionType.description: Optional doc type to convert to, e.g. pdf, html, xml (for XML/CDA files).

fileName.description: The file name of the document (from metriport_list_documents).

name: metriport_get_document_url
title: Get document download URL
